messages.subject: Harburn — non-payment and wrongful termination
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

We need your help. Harburn Utilities purported to terminate our 3-year SaaS agreement on 8 August claiming "persistent unavailability and data-integrity failures". The allegation is nonsense — availability was 99.83%+ every month and they never raised a single service-credit claim. They also owe us £669,000 in invoices.

We accepted their repudiation on 1 September. Can you advise on recovery and next steps?

Henry Larsson
CEO
Caspian Technologies Limited

messages.plaintextBody:
Henry,

Thanks — this looks strong on the debt and good on the loss-of-bargain claim. James Osei will lead day to day with me supervising. First step is a pre-action letter before claim; please send us the agreement, the Go-Live certificate, the monthly availability reports and the four unpaid invoices.

We'll get an engagement letter and our terms over to Sofia today.

Sarah Whitfield
Partner
Whitfield Carter LLP
